issue.title: Statements with quoted column names are rejected at row 1
issue.body:
Since our bank changed its export last week, every statement we upload is
rejected straight away with

    Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header

and "Problem found at row 1". The first line of the file is
`"Date","Amount","Description","Reference"`, with every name in double quotes.
If I delete the quotes on that first line only and upload again, the whole file
imports, quotes on the transaction lines and all.
## Discussion

### lena-k (maintainer) · 2026-11-03
Thanks. Do the transaction lines have quotes around every field as well?

### treasury-ops-lund · 2026-11-03
Yes, every field on every line is quoted, and those lines are read fine once
the first line has no quotes.

input.title: Parse quoted header names in statement uploads
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In parseStatement, the header line is split with lines[0].split(",") so quoted names keep their quote characters (e.g. "\"date\""). assertShape then finds no required columns and raises errors.rowShape at row 1. Change it to use splitFields(lines[0]) before lower-casing, so the header is unquoted the same way data rows are.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Thanks for the detailed report; here is what triage found.

parseStatement splits the header line with a plain split(","), so quoted names keep their quote characters and the required columns (date, amount, description) are never found. Data rows go through splitFields, which handles quotes, and that is why they read fine. The draft PR switches the header to splitFields.

In short: parseStatement splits the header line with a plain split(","), so quoted names keep their quote characters and the required columns (date, amount, description) are never found.

This triage rests on the issue as it was filed and on what RepoMind's own reads of the repository returned. If any of it looks wrong, a maintainer can change the label or close the draft pull request. Nothing has been merged.
